app_documentation:
StudyCircle is a web and mobile-web (responsive) collaborative learning platform for university students. It helps students share study notes, find classmates in the same courses, and organize study groups in one place. Access is limited to verified students: registration requires a university email whose domain matches a supported university, and accounts stay pending until the emailed verification link is used. The app is built with React on the front end and Node.js/Express on the back end, exposing a REST API plus WebSocket for real-time messaging. It uses PostgreSQL for data, AWS S3 for file storage, and JWT authentication, with bcrypt-hashed passwords and HTTPS for all traffic.

The MVP has five features. (F1) User Registration and Profiles: students sign up with a university email, receive a verification email, and maintain a public profile with their major and courses. (F2) Study Notes Sharing: students upload PDF or image notes up to 20 MB with a title, course, and optional topic tags. Uploads are virus-scanned before publishing. Students can browse, search with full-text search, filter by course and topic, sort by relevance or rating, rate, and bookmark notes. (F3) Study Groups: students create public or private course groups, and the creator becomes Group Admin. Admins approve or reject join requests and remove members, and students discover and join groups through search. (F4) Group Discussion and Messaging: group members post messages in a feed that updates within 5 seconds, attach notes, like messages, and receive in-app notifications with a per-group toggle and unread badge. (F5) Moderation and Reporting: users report notes or posts with a reason, and moderators review the queue, then remove or dismiss content. Removed content is hidden and the uploader is notified.

The intended users are four roles. Students are the primary audience and use notes, groups, and messaging. Group Admins are students who manage membership of their own groups. Moderators review reports and enforce content and copyright rules. System Administrators operate the platform. Platform roles are stored in users.platform_role, and the Group Admin role is contextual, stored per group in group_members.role. The UI is a mobile-first, card-based design with indigo branding (primary #4F46E5), the Inter typeface, and bottom navigation (Notes, Upload, Groups, Profile) that becomes a left sidebar on tablet and desktop. Core flows such as upload note, join group, and report content take three clicks or fewer. The design meets WCAG AA accessibility, with 44px touch targets and screen-reader labels.

Non-functional targets: pages load in under 2 seconds and search returns in under 1 second at 500 concurrent users, with 99.5% monthly uptime excluding scheduled maintenance. User data is deletable on request within 30 days in line with GDPR principles, tracked in data_deletion_requests. The delivery plan (StudyCircle MVP Plan) has 14 tasks (T1-T14), running from database design and app shell through feature builds to final QA, load testing, and production deployment with monitoring. Key risks are virus-scan integration, WebSocket complexity (with a polling fallback), email deliverability and the university domain allowlist, performance and uptime on a small team, and the legal work needed for copyright takedown and GDPR.
baseline_artifacts: Requirements_v1 (StudyCircle features F1-F5, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical and non-functional requirements, user roles)
Design_v1 (design system, color scheme, typography, bottom navigation, 7 screens, UI components, responsive, accessibility, animations, icons)

Database_v1 (PostgreSQL schema of 19 tables with indexes, relationships, and assumptions, including universities, users, notes, study_groups, group_messages, reports, moderation_actions, data_deletion_requests)
CyclePlan_v1 (StudyCircle MVP Plan with tasks T1-T14, dependencies, estimates, and risk register)

glossary.Study Note: A PDF or image file (maximum 20 MB) uploaded by a student, stored in AWS S3, and organized by university, course, and topic. It carries a title, scan status, and rating, and is published only after a clean virus scan.
glossary.Study Group: A course-specific group that students create or join to collaborate. It is public (instant join) or private (admin approval required), and has a message feed.
glossary.Group Admin: A per-group role, held by the group creator by default, that can approve or reject join requests and remove members. It is stored in group_members.role and is separate from platform roles.
glossary.Moderator: A platform role (users.platform_role = moderator) that reviews reported notes and posts in the moderation queue and removes or dismisses content, with each decision recorded in moderation_actions.
glossary.Verified Student: A user whose university email domain matches a university's allowed email_domain and who has completed the emailed verification token. The account moves from pending_verification to active.
glossary.Report: A user submission flagging a note or group message as inappropriate, copyrighted, spam, harassment, or other. It is queued as pending for moderator review and resolved as removed or dismissed.
